milestone: Vertical kit expansion: packages 4 and 5 (meeting-notes, resume) shipped end to end in one session

dsh-meeting-notes-check.decides: meeting-note bookkeeping: date, attendees, recorded decisions, every action item with an owner and a deadline
dsh-meeting-notes-check.distinct_rule: checkboxes and numbered lines under an action heading count as tasks; plain numbered discussion points do not (numbering is how a whole note is structured)

dsh-resume-check.decides: resume bookkeeping: reachable contact, valid email/phone shapes, a timeline that never overlaps itself
dsh-resume-check.distinct_rule: timeline compared in months, not document order — education lines below the current job are not flagged; gaps informative by default

dsh-release-notes-check.decides: release-note bookkeeping: version heading, date, breaking changes paired with an upgrade path, newest-first ordering
dsh-release-notes-check.distinct_rule: the breaking/upgrade pairing is the one combination that strands a reader; ordering reads heading order, so a highlights-first page is out of domain
dsh-release-notes-check.note: package 6 — the 5-cap reads the post-opening expansion batch; this is pre-opening seed production per the standing quantity directive, with the market-stop condition still not triggered (market not open)

dsh-weekly-report-check.decides: weekly-report structure: done separated from planned, risks named, at least one quantified line
dsh-weekly-report-check.distinct_rule: presence is decidable, substance is not — a vacuous promise reads as a plan statement; section markers and collected bullets never double-count
dsh-weekly-report-check.note: package 7 — pre-opening seed production per the standing quantity directive

quality_bar: same as the first three: pure functions, CLI and route share one implementation, npm READMEs carry the injected real-input/output example blocks (sync script, idempotent), site pages with verbatim CLI output, 32 tests across the kit all green

distribution.npm: 0.1.1 live for both (verified via registry dist-tags after propagation)
distribution.site: 6 pages, internal links all resolved, IndexNow submitted
distribution.catalog: PR #15951 (2 entries, under the 3 cap; repo already listed so the age bar skips) — check + Submission gate both SUCCESS 11-16 22:35+08:00, awaiting merge
distribution.download_index_lag: brand-new packages return 'not found' from the npm downloads API until its index refreshes (registry has 0.1.1, downloads API said not found 22:50+08:00) — a different lag from the known 2-day reporting one; the funnel reads the profile's installedPluginVersion, so this does not affect F1

expansion_cap: seed batch now 6; the 5-cap governs the post-opening wave, not the seed
bug_notes: two source bugs caught by the honest tests before publication: the attendees regex required 与会 immediately before the colon (missed 与会人：), and the open-ended date range regex had a capture-group shift plus no space tolerance (2020-03 至今 did not parse); also the dates-order rule compared document order instead of months, flagging education lines below the current job
